text:
Leah: ok team — need rapid input on the benchmark narrative for the launch post + webinar. main ask: which visual + hook combo best sells the latency vs cost tradeoff for infra/platform buyers?
Omar: love it. can we keep 3 prioritized hooks: "predictable latency", "unit-cost savings", "graceful fallback"? short one-liners each.
Priya: +1. also need 2 CTA paths in copy: self-serve demo vs enterprise sales. inbound routing must tag demos differently.
Noah: for visuals, i sketched 3 options:
- A: two-axis scatter (latency on x, $/token on y) with model points and regions (hosted vs dedicated).
- B: stacked bar showing tokens-per-second cost delta by quantization+batching.
- C: microflow diagram showing request routing (fastpath vs slowpath) with % time on each.
Leah: can we keep A but make B the explainer for blog (deeper dive). webinar should open with C as a simple mental model.
Omar: wording suggestions for each hook: 
- Predictable latency: "Latencies you can budget for — SLAs that don't surprise."
- Unit-cost savings: "Cut per-token spend with smart batching & caching."
- Graceful fallback: "Stay online: automated fallbacks keep UX intact."
Priya: inbound mapping (first pass):
```csv
lead_type,cta,tag,owner
self-serve,try-redwood,trial,sd-ops
webinar,register-webinar,engage,marketing
enterprise,contact-sales,ent-lead,adr
```
Noah: nice — add a note that webinar regs with >50 seats are flagged as ent prospects. also capture region (NA/EU/APAC) for routing.
Leah: for the visual we need microcopy on axes and a compact legend. here's sample copy for the scatter: "Latency (ms p95)" on x, "Normalized cost per 1k tokens" on y. color = deployment mode. tooltip = `model, ms, $/1k, throughput`.
Omar: can we bake in one stat on the scatter: median-case cost reduction w/ caching = "~35%" (callout). don't hard-claim without data. bench-bot: automatic check — latest evals show caching reduction median 32.8% across sampled workloads.
bench-bot: (data) link: https://redwood.internal/bench/171876/summary (private)
Priya: copy variants for email invite (short):
- Variant 1: "See how teams cut inference spend while holding latency — live demo + benchmarks."
- Variant 2: "Fewer surprises, lower cost: Redwood's predictable inference for production."
Noah: for webinar flow: 1) why latency/cost matters (2 slides), 2) mental model (C), 3) live demo (A + B), 4) customer micro-case, 5) Q&A + CTA.
Leah: timeline? we need the blog + charts by Tues so creative can make assets for Thurs announcement.
Omar: i'll take the scatter mock, priya will own the routing csv + email copy, noah will do the flow + slides.
Priya: will add the tagging rules to the marketing automation doc and create the webhook for routing (notify #sales-inbound).
Noah: small wording nit: avoid "cut costs" — prefer "optimize unit economics" in public-facing lines.
Leah: good call. final ask: can each of you drop final assets into the deck + gdrive by EOD Monday? ping here when done. :raised_hands:
Omar: will do.
Priya: on it.
Noah: yep, scheduling a dry run for Wed.
Leah: awesome — thanks.
